key_findings.scope_determines_control: Bounded text (Spell 6) caps Pe below D1. Unbounded text (Divine Name) allows Pe to reach Fisher Runaway. The spell IS the control mechanism.
key_findings.deactivation_channel_matters: Verbal command fails above D2 (boundary eroded — entity no longer receives creator authority). Deception works precisely BECAUSE of high R — the entity's responsiveness is exploited. Inscription modification is direct α intervention.
key_findings.enkidu_symmetry: Golem: Pe rising (constraint erosion). Enkidu: Pe falling (constraint acquisition). Both cross Pe=1. Shamhat's civilizing of Enkidu is a constraint specification event.
key_findings.distributed_vs_singular: Ushabti system (401 bounded servants) is inherently safer than golem system (1 unbounded agent). Many low-Pe agents > one high-Pe agent for controllability.
